senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. טוּשׁ II)to sink, drop (cmp.
units: Num. XI, 31); to abandon, let alone, v. infra.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75:11">Gen. R. s. 75</cite> <he>אם רחקת ונָטַשְׁתָּה וכ׳</he> if thou wert to reject and abandon Jacob &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 653">Yalk. Ps. 653</cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 6b:11">Snh. 6ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 17:14">Prov. XVII, 14</cite>) <he>לנַטְּשׁוֹ</he> to drop it (the case, to compromise), v. <cite ref="C00974"><he>גָּלַע</he></cite>; Tanḥ.

senses.gloss: to be torn loose, be released. Pesik. Baḥod., p. 154ᵇ ני׳ מחורש וכ׳ (not מחודש) released from one thicket and caught &c.; ib. נו׳; Yalk. Num. 782 נו׳ וכ׳; (Y. Taan. II, 65ᵈ top ניתור, v. נָתַר I; Lev. R. s. 29, a. e. ניתש, v. נָתַשׁ).
